title: gagea lutea f. maxima
intro: Gagea lutea f. maxima, commonly known as the large yellow gagea, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Liliaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The large yellow gagea is believed to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Gagea lutea f. maxima include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and oxidative stress.
